title: Fix GitHub Actions shell mismatch in Attic upload step
Add ccd-tools Rust package and CCD status report
description: Add a local Rust tool that reads named Concordium accounts from a runtime CSV file and reports their staked and available balances from CCDExplorer.
close_reason: Implemented ccd-tools and Home Manager runtime-secret wrappers; all Rust, Nix, NUR, wrapper, and live checks passed.
implementation: Implemented ccd-tools as a local Rust package with a shared AccountsArgs CSV reader, CCDExplorer mainnet client, validator/delegator parsing, compact CCD formatting, and the ccd-status binary. Added a Home Manager module at lib.homeManagerModules.ccd-tools that wraps every packaged binary with a runtime CCD_TOOLS_ACCOUNTS default while allowing environment and CLI overrides. Added offline Rust fixtures/CLI tests, a Nix wrapper check, documentation, and Rust development tools.
manual_tests: Run ccd-status --accounts /path/to/accounts.csv with Name,Address rows, or pipe decrypted CSV with --accounts -. In Home Manager import inputs.nur-packages.lib.homeManagerModules.ccd-tools, enable programs.ccd-tools, and set accountsFile to config.sops.secrets.ccd-accounts.path; then invoke ccd-status without arguments. Verify --accounts overrides the configured default. Automated checks: 11 Rust tests, Clippy with warnings denied, Nix package and wrapper builds, restricted NUR evaluation, and flake check. Live validator/delegator queries returned compact reports.
